title: Concept: Dependency allowed to float within its minor line
description: package.json declares a `~` specifier that accepts every patch release, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `~` specifier that accepts every patch release.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
